requirements.requirement: The system must count the number of valid measures available in the scoring input prior to any score computation.
The system must define a valid measure as one that is non-null, passes normalization, and is eligible for scoring inclusion.
The system must enforce a minimum threshold of 3 valid measures before allowing score calculation to proceed.
The system must short-circuit the scoring pipeline when the valid measure count is less than 3.
The system must return a structured insufficiency response when fewer than 3 valid measures are present.
The system must allow score calculation to proceed when the valid measure count is equal to or greater than 3.
The system must correctly handle the boundary condition where exactly 3 valid measures are present and proceed with scoring.
The system must exclude invalid, null, or malformed measures from the valid measure count.
The system must not attempt partial scoring or return intermediate scores when the minimum threshold is not met.
The system must log the valid measure count and validation outcome for each scoring request.
The system must handle empty input (no measures provided) by returning an insufficiency response without error.
The system must handle inputs where all measures are invalid by returning an insufficiency response.
The system must ensure the validation logic executes before any downstream weighting or normalization logic.
The system must produce deterministic validation results for the same input set of measures.
